description: Returns a list of Attachments for the specified Test Step Result. Cardinality: targets the full collection or a batch. For a single item by ID, use `getTestStepResultAttachment` instead.

additionalProperties.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include for this resource type

fields.description: Sparse fieldset selector: an object keyed by resource type (e.g. `workitems`) whose value is a comma-separated list of attribute names to return (e.g. `id,title,status`), reducing payload size. Omit to return the default field set.

include.description: Comma-separated list of related resource types to embed in the response (e.g. `author,attachments`) so they don't require a separate follow-up call. Omit to return only the primary resource.

iteration.description: The iteration number identifying which repeated occurrence of this item is being addressed (e.g. which run of a test parameter).

max_items.description: Collect up to this many results across pages (maximum 1000). Omit to fetch only the requested page, as before.

page_number_.description: 1-based page number to fetch when the result set is paginated (e.g. `2` for the second page). Combine with `page[size]`; omit to fetch the first page.

page_size_.description: Maximum number of items to return in this page (e.g. `100`). Use together with `page[number]` to paginate through a large result set.

projectId.description: The Polarion project ID (its URL segment, e.g. `myproject`), case-sensitive. Required to scope the request to one project. If the ID is unknown, ask the user; getProjects lists IDs only with global read access.

response_format.description: Response detail level. concise removes redundant HTML and JSON:API metadata and may use a small default fieldset on large lists; detailed preserves the complete response. Defaults to detailed.

revision.description: A specific repository revision (e.g. `1234`) to read the resource as it existed at that revision instead of the current HEAD. Omit to use the latest revision.

testCaseId.description: The Test Case's ID being referenced.

testCaseProjectId.description: The project ID that owns the referenced Test Case — may differ from the project in the request path when the test case is shared from another project.

testRunId.description: The Test Run's ID within its project.
